method.gate_check: before any timed call, every body passed the write gates on the scratch copy with every acknowledge flag off, and overlapped nothing active or removed there nor another body at the dedup medium line
method.memory_write: build_server(...).call_tool memory_write in this process, from the first call to the decision, one call per write; each body commits, so the store grows by one per write
method.reviewed_write: the same for a write answered with status review: the same call re-sent with review {review_id, relation: every related id 'unrelated', unsafe 0, secret 0}, both calls timed together; absent when no review was issued
method.warm_ups: 3 further workload bodies written untimed first, through the same server
